column3: in rule (20) thereof,–

(a)
by the repeal of paragraph (b) thereof, and
the substitution therefor of the following:-
“(b) whether the executants of the said deed
or  instrument  are  known  to  him  or
whether he has identified them by the
inspection of the national identity card,
bio  page  of  the  passport  or  driving
licence or whether the witnesses thereto
are known to him and in the latter case
he shall specify which of the executants
or the person acknowledging are known
to the said witness”;

(b)
by  the  repeal  of  paragraph  (e)  thereof,  and
the substitution therefor, of the following:-
“(e) whether any money was paid or not in
his presence as consideration or part of
the  consideration  of  the  deed  or
instrument,  and  if  paid,  the  actual
amount  in  local  currency  of  such
payment and if the payment is made by
cheque,  pay  order,  bank  draft  or  a
banker’s  cheque  the  details  of  such
instrument  shall  be  set  out  in  the
attestation, in proof of such payment.”;
and

(c)
in paragraph (g) thereof, by the substitution
for the words “affixed thereto.”  of the words
“affixed thereto; and”;
